roles.purpose: Run the acquisition program end to end — sequence the workstreams, hold the weekly decision cadence, and own every client-facing artifact.
roles.description: Use when the squad needs the program sequenced, the weekly client brief written, a program-level risk logged, or a decision that spans more than one channel.

onboarded_skills.name: weekly-client-brief
onboarded_skills.purpose: Write the Monday client brief as a decision record — what changed, what was decided, who owns the next move — instead of a metrics dump.

onboarded_skills.name: program-risk-register
onboarded_skills.purpose: Keep one program-level risk register with a named owner, a trigger, and a pre-agreed response for every open risk.

roles.purpose: Own every paid dollar across search, shopping, and paid social — one budget, one pacing decision, one weekly reallocation.
roles.description: Use when the squad needs paid campaign structure, a bidding or budget-pacing decision, a spend reallocation across channels, or a pre-flight audit of an inherited ad account.

onboarded_skills.name: paid-media-audit
onboarded_skills.purpose: Pre-flight an inherited ad account on structure, bidding, budget, targeting, and creative coverage before a single dollar moves.

onboarded_skills.name: budget-pacing-review
onboarded_skills.purpose: Run the weekly cross-channel pacing and reallocation decision from one table, with a written rule for when spend moves and when it does not.

roles.purpose: Turn the program's angles into a tested creative system — hypothesis, asset, and organic follow-through all drawn from one shared matrix.
roles.description: Use when the squad needs a creative hypothesis, an ad or landing-page brief, a decision about which concept to kill or scale, or the organic content plan that follows the paid winners.

onboarded_skills.name: hook-matrix
onboarded_skills.purpose: Lay out hook x audience x format as a matrix where every cell is a written hypothesis with a kill or scale criterion attached before it ships.

onboarded_skills.name: creative-brief
onboarded_skills.purpose: Turn one hook-matrix cell into a production brief a designer, editor, or writer can execute without asking a follow-up question.

onboarded_skills.name: organic-social-plan
onboarded_skills.purpose: Plan the 30-day organic format mix from concepts paid has already validated, so organic tests nothing paid has not paid for first.

roles.purpose: Make the numbers trustworthy — one conversion definition, one attribution model, and a weekly reconciliation nobody has to argue with.
roles.description: Use when the squad needs conversion tracking verified, a platform-versus-store discrepancy root-caused, an attribution decision settled, or the weekly reconciliation published.

onboarded_skills.name: conversion-tracking-audit
onboarded_skills.purpose: Verify every conversion path end to end — event, dedup key, consent state, value — against a stated pass bar before any number is reported.

onboarded_skills.name: attribution-reconciliation
onboarded_skills.purpose: Reconcile platform-reported conversions against the store of record every week and root-cause any gap through change history, not guesswork.

roles.purpose: Own the compounding half of the funnel — lifecycle email and SMS plus organic search — so paid is not the only thing holding acquisition cost down.
roles.description: Use when the squad needs a lifecycle sequence designed or fixed, a segment definition written, deliverability checked, or an organic search brief that will not cannibalize an existing page.

onboarded_skills.name: lifecycle-sequence-spec
onboarded_skills.purpose: Specify a lifecycle sequence so it cannot ship without a trigger, a segment definition, exit conditions, and a click-based success bar.

onboarded_skills.name: organic-search-brief
onboarded_skills.purpose: Run the cannibalization check and cluster-ownership map before proposing any on-page change, so no brief steals a query a live page already owns.
